## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Grouping | Group columns | `group_columns` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Comma-separated grouping columns. Required. |
| Grouping | Aggregations | `aggregations` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Comma-separated COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX, MEDIAN, MODE or STRING_AGG(column) expressions; optional AS alias. Required. |
| Text aggregation | Text order columns | `text_order_by` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Required for STRING_AGG: comma-separated numeric/text columns, ascending, nulls last. Equal keys use text as tie-break. Null text is skipped; all-null groups return null. |
| Text aggregation | Text separator | `text_separator` | Text | ` ` |   | The run | Literal separator for STRING_AGG; default is one space. Empty joins without a separator. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).
